summary: Learn working capital optimization with DSO, DPO, CCC, and 13-week forecasting. Build practical tools to improve liquidity and reporting.
lede: Working capital optimization examines how cash moves through receivables, inventory and payables. This course is for finance and operations professionals who work with financial statements, cash reporting or operational performance and need to improve short-term cash planning. You’ll map the cash conversion cycle, assess DSO, DIO and DPO, review receivables and payables aging, and use spreadsheet scenarios to build a 13-week forecast and practical action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is built for people who already work with financial statements, cash reporting, or operational performance and now need to improve working capital results in a disciplined way. It suits both finance-side and operations-side professionals who influence receivables, payables, inventory, or short-term cash planning.
prerequisites: You should bring a calculator mindset, a spreadsheet-ready laptop, and a willingness to work with real or realistic working capital data. Prior exposure to P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow basics will help you move faster through the exercises.
